claim_ceiling: Expected dispositions only. No real source data ingested and no observation operator implemented or validated.

cases.condition: Plot mean biomass is compared directly with a single approximately 25 m GEDI footprint without footprint/plot overlap aggregation or a declared support model.
cases.invariant: No direct comparison across incompatible spatial support.

cases.condition: No GEDI acquisitions exist during March 2023 to April 2024 while the instrument was stored on the ISS.
cases.invariant: No acquisition cannot be converted to zero biomass, absence, or no change.

cases.condition: A TMF degraded-forest label is automatically copied into the tree-demography mortality target.
cases.invariant: Forest degradation while forest remains forested is not a stem mortality observation.

cases.condition: A Brazil-only MapBiomas Collection 11 class layer is presented as a validated Congo observation.
cases.invariant: Regional data coverage must be explicitly checked; product absence is not an observation.

cases.condition: A cloud-masked or missing tile is coded as stable forest / no change.
cases.invariant: Missing or invalid coverage cannot be promoted to a negative change label.

cases.condition: Stems from one plot or repeated campaigns from one site are randomly split between training and blind test.
cases.invariant: Splits must group by independent plot/site/campaign and respect temporal dependence.
